title: Wirelang Layer 2 — Semantic Frame (Domain vs. Meta Events)
description: Schema for the Wirelang Layer-2 semantic frame envelope. Distinguishes domain events (wakir.<domain>.*) from meta events (wakir.meta.*) by namespace and pins schema-registry, vocabulary, and validity-window metadata. SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

frame_class.description: Classification namespace. domain-event = business semantics (task.assigned, audit.anchor.created). meta-event = protocol-level signaling (capability.issued, schema.deprecation, persona.rotated).

schema_id.description: Schema-registry identifier. Domain events MUST NOT use the 'wakir.meta.' prefix; meta events MUST use 'wakir.meta.'.

vocabulary.description: Wakir vocabulary anchor. Layer-2 references the vocabulary version that defined the role/term strings used in this frame.

validuntil.description: Schema-version validity window end (RFC 3339) or null for open-ended.

supersedes.description: Predecessor schema_version this frame replaces, if any.

overlap_with.description: Overlapping-validity-window declarations for soft schema migrations.

ots_anchor_path.description: Cross-review zone 3 path proposal: OpenTimestamps file path for this schema/vocabulary version. Pending WAT-module owner consensus stamp.

payload.description: Domain-specific or meta-specific payload. Schema is enforced by the document referenced via schema_id+schema_version, not by this envelope.
